notes.title: Build 3.1.06 Patch Notes
notes.content:
3.1.06

Added a new splash image to the loading screen.
Updated the roadmap image.
Fixed an issue with the dart board appearing in other scenes.
Fixed the geese pathing through tables.

notes.title: Phase 4 arrives with new features
notes.content:
Changes for Phase 4

 Added multi-items. From the Play Settings you can adjust how often multi-items occur and how many items are used.
 Added a new scene, Game Room.
 Added a new 8 minute song, Tropical Ride.
 Achievements have been added, 1 for each of the 15 unlockable hats.
 The loading times have been improved.
 Added 2 new items totaling 26.
 Practice has been renamed to Standard. All descriptions have been updated.
 Removed leaderboard and challenges, and any association with the server. This feature may come back in future updates. Note: The Twitch Integration is unchanged and still works as expected.


The leaderboard functionality wasn't seeing as much usage as we would have liked, so the leaderboards have been temporarily removed. No game content was changed because of this, but guesses will no longer be uploaded and ranked on our server.

This decision did not come lightly but it made sense given most of our users utilize the Twitch integration to play along with their stream audience. We hope to one day readd this feature and we still have all of the code ready to reactivate. We will continue to evaluate reactivating leaderboards given the size and demand of users playing Goosey Guess.

We also lumped phase 3 and 4 together into one release since we had everything ready to go.


Hats have been reorganized

 Sun hat - Submit a guess with every item (replaced daily challenge).
 Beret - Submit a guess with every container (replaced weekly challenge).
 Nurse - Submit a guess on all 3 scenes (replaced 25 challenges).
 Fez - Spend a total of 45 minutes making guesses (replaced challenge with 90% accuracy).
 Wizard - Connect to Twitch (replaced view leaderboard).
 Sombrero - 100 guesses (replaced 10 leaderboard guesses).
 Fedora - Play a Custom game with 1 item and 1 container selected (replaced 3 consecutive daily challenges).


If you unlocked a hat with its previous goal, the hat will remain unlocked with this update. Additionally all achievements will be earned for existing unlocked hats the first time they are viewed.

As always, we welcome your feedback and comments. The best place to reach us is on our Discord server!

notes.title: Halloween has come to Goosey Guess!
notes.content:
Patch notes 2.3.01


 Halloween update. Gary and Gina are ready for trick-or-treaters.
 The automated camera has been updated so that if you manually take control, the camera will not try to fight for control.
 The camera will no longer respond when begining to rotate over an interface element. This was causing the camera to move when using the interface.

notes.title: Goosey Guess just became automated!
notes.content:
You guys asked for it and it is here! Goosey Guess now has a fully automated "Host" mode where chat can play without you having to guess! In Host mode, you can set the timer for how long Last Call should be along with how much time should pass between rounds. The game will not only start the round automatically but Last Call is now fully automated as well. No more forgetting to click the Last Call button! Our new automated camera provides an improved visual experience as well as allowing for chat to fully view the items without you moving the camera. You can set it, forget it and let chat enjoy the game without your attention to it. We have also added some frequently requested QoL changes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44085400/e99049be40c807246d93aa3545265655d49f0591.gif

Patch Notes 2.2.03

 The camera code has been redesigned to allow for better viewing angles, particularly from the top-down. The zoom on the camera is now much smoother.
 An automated camera has been added.
 The container can now automatically be hidden as the round starts.
 [Streamer Mode] An option to automatically begin the next round after a certain amount of time has been added.
 [Streamer Mode] Host mode has been added. If "Streamer Mode" is enabled, a new option is available in the play settings that allow you to host the game without guessing.
 [Streamer Mode] An option to automatically begin the "Last Call" countdown has been added.
 [Streamer Mode] Options for the "Last Call"  countdown have been added to allow a maximum of 5 minutes.
 [Streamer Mode] The streamer's guess will update automatically in the list of guesses as it changes as opposed to at the end of the round.
 [Streamer Mode] Rankings have been added to the results panel.

notes.title: Phase 1 has arrived!
notes.content:
It has been 6 weeks since our release and boy has the game evolved. Not only have we become Twitch interactive, but we are also releasing our biggest patch to date. The community spoke and we listened! Many of the changes in this patch have been fueled by players like you! The highlight of this patch is our challenge mode promised in the roadmap, but we also added some new features and surprises. We have redesigned some items, added some new containers and items, improved Twitch streaming with new features, and added a new goose to join Gary in the fun!

New Challenge Mode
We have added a new mode which serves up daily and weekly challenges for players. You can now participate to earn points for your online profile. Challenges are a way to compete with others using the same items, containers, and difficulty. 

 Each round, the amount you are off by accumulates. 
 Once all rounds have finished for the challenge, your details are ranked against others. 
 Points are earned for completing the challenge and for placing in the top guessers. 
 Challenges are timed and a guess must be submitted before time runs out. If time does run out, a guess of 0 will be entered! Challenge guesses are automatically submitted as leaderboard guesses. 
 If a Challenge times out and submits 0, it will be ignored for the leaderboards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44085400/d72c2f4ad7682041e37eefd0ade1222bdfc1cfd9.png
New Items and Containers
5 new items and 4 new containers  have entered the game to continue to challenge you. In addition, we have reworked a few items and a container for a better player experience. You can expect to find the following additions and changes in the game:

New Items

 Pebble
 Jack
 Packing Peanut
 Bead
 Eraser

New Containers

 Colander
 Tankard
 Styrofoam Cup
 Vase

Reworked Items and Containers

 Medicine Bottle
 Bottle Cap
 Pill
 Wok

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44085400/46d9cdb486d58cdac23f7a2b7f53c84d9c399362.gif

New Goose

Gary has really become a show stopper. Almost everyone that we watch play loves Gary the goose. While Gary loves your company he also needed a mate to share his house with. Meet Gina! You will need to earn Gina's trust before she will enter the house by earning 6 hats. She is just as stylish as Gary and has a huge love for hats!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44085400/55cc7b0340d4b0d3510c0f2100aa90f6f45df908.png

New Hats

You guys love the hats! We had such great feedback from the addition of the original 10 hats that we decided to add more. Work to unlock the following hats so that you can customize your goose:

 Beret
 Nurse
 Fez
 Fedora
 Sunhat 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44085400/c0788465868ca04b4d5acfa3b3a834264fc3ed42.gif

Quality of Life Changes

 Simple can no longer be selected while the leaderboard is active.
 The main menu background noise is now adjustable.
 The number of seconds taken for each guess has been corrected.
 The number of guesses this session has been moved to the start buttons.
 A new tab has been added to the options menu. The "Goose" tab allows you to select your goose as well as view progress.
 [Streamer Mode] Clear points has been moved to the main screen. A confirmation message has also been added for "Clear points" as well as "Clear guesses".
 [Streamer Mode] Twitch will reconnect the next time you play if you quit while connected.
 [Streamer Mode] A new tab "Average Points" has been added which gives the average points recieved for each player.
 [Streamer Mode] A new mode has been added, "Don't Go Over". As opposed to getting points for being the closest, you only get points if you do not go over the total. The streamer can select the desired mode in Options > Twitch.

notes.title: Build 1.3.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.3.01

This update features many changes that prepare for the Challenges update coming. Challenges are now in private testing and performing as expected, though it will be several week before this feature is ready for the public.

The tutorial menu has been swapped to the left side of the screen.
The Options menu has been slightly redesigned. Additionally a "Hats" tab has been added.
Time is now tracked on all guesses.
The Guess Results screen has been slightly changed. The "Average Accuracy" stat was confusing and is replaced with elapsed time for the guess.
Items now move slightly faster in Prove It mode.
[Streamer Mode] Added a countdown feature to give a warning for final guesses.

notes.title: Build 1.2.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.2.12

The Physics, bounciness, and friction of many items and surfaces have been updated.
The camera can now be set to follow Gary.

notes.title: Build 1.2.08 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.2.08

Hats are now locked behind tasks. Head to the profile section in the Options menu to view the hats.
A popup will be shown when a hat is unlocked.
Gary can now be clicked on. He may or may not like it.
The camera can now be moved to a different location in Prove It mode. This feature is still a work in progress and will be refined.
[Twitch Integration] Points can now be cleared from the Twitch menu.

notes.title: Build 1.2.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.2.03

Added points and rankings to Twitch streamer mode.

notes.title: Build 1.2.01 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.2.01

Gary the goose can now be customized with 10 different hats.
Goosey Guess now has a setting to allow the application to run in the background.

notes.title: Build 1.1.13 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.1.13

Added Median calculation to Twitch streamer mode.
Pedestals could possibly clip through the Large Pot on Goosey. This has been fixed.
The camera will no longer zoom from the mouse scroll when hovering over the UI.
Turning invalid items invisible will not happen within the first 1.5 seconds of spawning if the "Hide Invalid" setting is enabled.
Sugar and Flour Canister are now slightly bigger
Some items were going slower than intended on 10x during Prove It mode.

notes.title: Build 1.1.09 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.1.09

 In Streamer Mode, guesses will automatically show "off by" in descending order instead of "amount guessed" when the round ends.
 Streamers can now sort guesses alphabetically by username, as well as "recent" and "amount".
 Guesses were not getting uploaded to the leaderboard for some users. This has been fixed.
 Collision detection improvements for a few containers.
 UI improvements for non-English languages.

notes.title: Build 1.0.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.0.12

 Fixed an issue with the "Leaderboard and Practice" option in View Stats not showing any values. This was caused by the upcoming Challenges addition for Phase 1.
 The guess amount will no longer default to 0 when clearing the value. This was causing a slightly awkward user experience when clearing a guess.

notes.title: Build 1.0.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
1.0.11

 The "Start" button will be disabled for 1 second after completing a guess. This will prevent a double click accidentally starting a new round without viewing the results.
 Fixed some pedestals clipping through the container on Goosey difficulty.
 Added information about Goosey difficulty in the play menu.
 Items and containers will now display their size in the results window if on the Goosey difficulty.
 The last 5 items on Practice and Leaderboard will be out of the random pool so that recent items will not be repeated.
 The last 3 containers on Practice and Leaderboard will be out of the random pool so that recent containers will not be repeated.
 The camera will be much less likely to get "flipped" upside down but this issue is still being addressed.

notes.title: The Geese Have Arrived
notes.content:
Goosey Guess officially launches today! Celebrate with us as the original guess simulator begins its journey towards an exciting future.

As we prepare for “Phase 1” in a few months, there are several changes already planned to release before then.

 Ability to hide invalid items
 Controller support
 Linux + SteamDeck support

We’ll release more information about daily and weekly challenges as we get closer to phase 1, but for now you can expect a new competitive system to keep you guessing towards the top of the leaderboards.

Feel free to leave us your idea for new features, enhancements, or think of any other Goosey requests, please join our Discord and let us know!
